: Yes. Ostrander Marine Finance SA was known to this inquiry from a bank statement showing
A register of 140 accounts, 4,382 tokens, fits the window with 2,556 tokens to spare. Asked for one
account at a time with the question after the register, LANTERN found 14 of 21: 2 of 3 in the first
twenty lines and 2 of 3 in the last. 4 of its 7 wrong answers had the right digits under another bank's
letters, a number on no line. With the question before the register it found 21; with the question both
before and after, 21. Moving the standing orders to the end of LANTERN's system message, with no word
changed, took the signed questions from 17 of 26 to 15 of 26: fixed Q-26, broken Q-03, Q-07, Q-18.
